displayName: OCI-AI-PD-001: AI — Prompt Injection via System Role Override
description:
Detects attempts to override system role instructions through user input manipulation

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: ai — prompt injection via system role override

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pd_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%prompt%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%injection%') AND "value" > 0
